name: Sangamon County, IL
findings: Sangamon County has 1,038 nonprofit organizations. 506 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 451 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sangamon County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
